title: Hatch patterns on triangle surfaces
description: Six boxes side-by-side, each carrying a `SceneMaterial` with a different hatch pattern. The picker in the intro toggles all five hatched materials between screen-space and world-space coordinate modes at runtime via `material.hatchPattern = …` and the `onSceneMaterialPatternChanged` re-encode path. Screen-space mode keeps spacing and line-width in pixels (camera-locked); world-space mode keeps them in world units (geometry-locked) — matching how a CAD package's material-fill hatches behave under zoom. Picking ignores the hatch in both modes.
